ch3_backbone_and_head_choice_20261012._what: Evidence for the network choice: why a MobileNetV2 backbone with a SimpleBaseline-style transposed-convolution heatmap head, and why that head is 32 channels wide and INT8. No training was run; every PCKh is a standalone re-score.

backbone_rows.what: ResNet-18 backbone + three 4x4 transposed convolutions of 256 channels + 1x1 output (SimpleBaseline)
backbone_rows.recipe: ImageNet ResNet-18, 120 epochs, ground-truth MSE, batch 64, lr 1e-3 (x0.1 at 80, 105)

backbone_rows.what: the same network, every layer INT8
backbone_rows.recipe: relay from the float model above, 30 epochs (best at 28), ground-truth MSE, batch 96

backbone_rows.what: ResNet-18 compressed for the device: stage 4 one block of 256 channels, head 32 channels
backbone_rows.precision: backbone ternary, head and output INT8
backbone_rows.recipe: own float student 50 epochs then 30 quantized epochs, both distilled from the ResNet-18 float model

backbone_rows.what: ResNet-18 with every 3x3 split into depthwise + pointwise, head 256 channels
backbone_rows.recipe: random initialisation (no ImageNet weights fit the split layers), 55 epochs distilled from the ResNet-18 float model
ImageNet MobileNetV2, 55 epochs distilled from the ResNet-18 float model
backbone relayed from the row above, head re-learned, 20 epochs distilled from the ResNet-18 float model
backbone relayed from the 256-channel depthwise-separable row, head re-learned, 20 epochs distilled

backbone_rows.what: MobileNetV2 + head 32 channels, pointwise and stem ternary
backbone_rows.precision: pointwise + stem ternary, depthwise, head and output INT8
backbone_rows.recipe: relay from the float 32-channel row, 10 epochs distilled from the ResNet-18 float model

ch3_backbone_and_head_choice_20261012.backbone_comparability: NOT one recipe: initialisation (ImageNet or random), epochs and distillation differ between families, so the PCKh column ranks the families only loosely. The weight, byte and MAC columns are properties of the architectures and are exact. Pairs that share a recipe: ResNet-18 float vs INT8 (relay); MobileNetV2 vs depthwise-separable ResNet-18 at 256 and at 32 head channels (same 55 / 20 epoch distillation schedule, differing only in ImageNet initialisation, which the separable ResNet cannot load).

head_rows.what: head 128 channels on the frozen ternary backbone
head_rows.precision: backbone pointwise + stem ternary, head INT8
head_rows.recipe: frozen backbone of the MPII + sports ternary model, head re-initialised, 18 epochs ground-truth MSE, MPII + sports

head_rows.what: head 128 channels on the frozen INT8 backbone
head_rows.recipe: frozen backbone of the MPII + sports INT8 model, head re-initialised, 18 epochs ground-truth MSE, MPII + sports

head_rows.what: head 32 channels plus three 1x1 lateral connections from backbone stages 13, 6 and 3 (skip-connected head)
head_rows.precision: backbone pointwise + stem ternary, head and laterals INT8
head_rows.recipe: same protocol as the 32-channel ternary head probe (frozen backbone, 18 epochs, ground-truth MSE, MPII + sports)

head_rows.what: ResNet-18 ternary backbone + head 64 channels, head ternary
head_rows.recipe: from the 64-channel float student, 25 quantized epochs distilled

head_rows.what: ResNet-18 ternary backbone + head 64 channels, head INT8
head_rows.precision: backbone ternary, head and output INT8
head_rows.recipe: from the same 64-channel float student, 30 quantized epochs distilled

ch3_backbone_and_head_choice_20261012.head_comparability: 128 vs 32 channels and skip vs plain head: one recipe (same frozen backbone, data, epochs, loss, fresh head). Their 32-channel control is the deployed model itself (probe_tern_dc32; for the INT8 pair probe_int8_dc32), whose standalone score is recorded in its own entry of this file and is deliberately not re-scored here. 256 vs 32 channels in float: relay, head re-learned with fewer epochs, so only near-same recipe. Ternary vs INT8 head on ResNet-18: same float student, 25 vs 30 quantized epochs.
ch3_backbone_and_head_choice_20261012.not_scored: The projection head (a ternary 1x1 from 320 to 64 channels before the transposed convolutions, earlier research repository experiments/mbv2_proj64_ftI30) was a continuation of an earlier model with no control trained for the same extra epochs, so it cannot be compared; it was not re-scored.

linux_driver_twn_fuse_20261026.note: The driver path is not slower. The 0.8-1.0 % difference is not attributed: the driver path changes three things at once (polling in the kernel with usleep_range instead of nanosleep in the app; the CPU mapping of the buffer, Normal non-cacheable instead of Device-nGnRnE; the buffer moves from the 0x6000_0000 reserved region to CMA at 0x5010_0000). The headline 228.7 fps stays the UIO number of thesis_model_probe_tern_dc32_board_20261012. STATUS bit 16 (ring overrun, sticky) is 0 after boot and 1 after a UIO-only run with the driver never loaded (C1_rollback_to_uio_dtb.txt): a property of the bitstream, not of the driver; outputs stay bit-exact; cause not investigated.
